title: Automatic spatial snapshot preparation and idle manual groups

environment.note: Development services and other user workloads may be active. No CPU affinity or host isolation.

method.aggregation: Median of three per-run means/percentiles/GC statistics, not a pooled percentile
method.timing: Uninstrumented source, official nengi-buffers writer, counting transport, controlled clock. Step excludes application mutation and spatial-index updates.
method.gc: Node PerformanceObserver GC events during the measured mutation/index/step loop; excludes forced warmup GC and result summarization
method.memory: Heap difference before construction vs after warmup, both after explicit GC; retained memory, not cumulative allocation
method.order: Fresh sequential processes, alternating variant order by case and repeat
method.metrics: Disabled except two named metrics controls. The named diagnostic control enables diagnostic binary writes and uses the ordinary visibility path.
method.limits: Not isolated from other host workloads. No sockets, clients, renderer or Jigsaw game loop in timed runs. Conservative membership invalidation can keep busy-frame tails unchanged.

source.description: Both variants contain the earlier pending server allocation and client sampling changes. This pass changes CellFragmentChannelOutput plus four regression tests.

probes.settings: 100 roots, eight users, two setup ticks and one measured tick, one occupied spatial cell; automatic/manual 2D/3D, shared on/off, idle/active
probes.countBoundary: Observed visibility comparisons, diff-cache lookups/computations, fragment membership construction and manual group membership construction; not allocated bytes
probes.validation: All 16 cases retain identical packet and decoded-state hashes before/after and instrumented/uninstrumented; all 20 timed cases retain bytes per tick and send counts
